capability_radar.watch: Accepted code and exact metadata installation; separately scoped scientific plan. No new service/tool required.

dimensions.build_vs_buy: ADOPT native parser, ResearchStore, writer lease, accounting and runner; one neighboring IO owner, no dependency/provider.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One contract, one connected evidence packet, bounded native form map; no duplicate PRD/SSD/audit.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Research gate only; no alpha, strategy promotion, executable return or cashflow evidence.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Frozen release/producer pins and saved negative result retained; known source deltas revalidate without per-day approval.
dimensions.mission: Current completeness makes the saved exploratory fragment reusable through native plan/check without renewing historical pins.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Native immutable receipt plus writer-lease CAS; crash retry idempotent; late deny retains pending; pause and saved reads remain available.
dimensions.owner_operability: Existing CLI status/preview/apply and fragment plan; exact source owner/reason/recovery. Installation and plan authority separate.
dimensions.red_team: Unknown producer/alias/version, source loss/revocation, mixed relabelled partitions, late deny, CAS/crash/root transplant tested.
dimensions.research_truth: Scoped complete-empty is distinct from advisory UNKNOWN, permission and independence; TASK22 v2 remains dataset/time-specific DENY.
dimensions.security: Source forms/versions, root identity, baseline retention and input metadata preflight fail closed before values.

recovery: Disable only dependent plan if necessary; retain restrictions, immutable receipts, saved evidence and native charges. Never restore permissive frozen parser as current authority.
